_description: Buttons fixed to the screen during the game (the HUD). Each widget opens a pop-up (popups.json) when clicked and counts toward '/ N read' like a '!' until it is read ('countsTowardCompletion'). Types: 'portrait' = Alex's face and name in the top-left corner; 'name' is the label, 'state' picks the built-in drawing ("sickly" after the data center, or "healthy"). 'noise' = a speaker button with volume bars in the bottom-left corner; the bars rise as Alex gets within 'range' tiles of 'source' (a tile kind, e.g. "data-center", or a list of kinds, e.g. the racks inside); 'ambientSound' (a sound in audio.json) hums in the background: 'ambientMinVolume' (0–1) anywhere on the map, rising to 'ambientVolume' right next to the source over 'ambientRange' tiles; 'musicDip' (0–1) = how much the music fades down next to the source.
